headline: Needs $450M for six months, 'absolutely brutal' conditions, ~50 attacks/day recorded
dek: WFP cut food aid to 500,000 in Gaza AND 200,000 in the West Bank due to a funding shortfall (not access): Gaza 1.6M->1.1M, West Bank 400k->200k; rations halved; hot meals cut from 250k to 150k daily; hard-to-reach/Yellow-Line areas get meals every other day; needs $450M. 1.4M Gazans (67%) in acute…
sources: UN WFP (Skau, Shaun Hughes); AFP; AP; news.un.org
fault_line: A funding failure, not a blockade failure: why is donor money drying up while 67% of Gaza is acutely food insecure?

sections.what_happened: WFP cut food aid to 500,000 in Gaza AND 200,000 in the West Bank due to a funding shortfall (not access): Gaza 1.6M->1.1M, West Bank 400k->200k; rations halved; hot meals cut from 250k to 150k daily; hard-to-reach/Yellow-Line areas get meals every other day; needs $450M. 1.4M Gazans (67%) in acute food insecurity; ~200k need immediate aid to prevent death from hunger.
sections.what_verified: UN News, AFP, AP, Khaleej Times, CNA, Daily Sabah, New Indian Express agree on all figures.
sections.what_disputed: None on the figures. Israel disputes the famine framing historically; the cuts are WFP's own announced decision driven by donor funding.
sections.why_matters: The forgotten ledger: while the Hormuz war dominates, the Gaza food pipeline is being cut in half for lack of $450M. Pocketbook-framing in reverse — the cost of donor fatigue.
sections.context: Background: Gaza/West Bank — UPDATE on totw-20261020-0400-09: cuts also hit 200,000 in the West Bank (400k->200k); acting WFP head Carl Skau: needs $450M for six months, 'absolutely brutal' conditions, ~50 attacks/day recorded; hot meals 250k->150k daily; rations halved

totw_analysis: Our read: The forgotten ledger: while the Hormuz war dominates, the Gaza food pipeline is being cut in half for lack of $450M. Pocketbook-framing in reverse — the cost of donor fatigue. The fault line our audience is arguing over: A funding failure, not a blockade failure: why is donor money drying up while 67% of Gaza is acutely food insecure?
